content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement affirmatively protects our freedom to buy and sell elsewhere. Section 1 states that "Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient," and adds that the Agreement "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."

I checked every other instance of "exclusive" in the document, and none bind AP:
- **p0002** — non-exclusive license granted *to* AP (favourable/neutral)
- **p0064** — exclusive jurisdiction and venue in New York (forum, not dealing)
- **p0065** — each Party's marks are its own exclusive property (mutual)
- **p0072 / p0073** — entire agreement and no-third-party-beneficiary boilerplate

Searches for sole-supplier, requirements-purchase, "shall not offer Inventory" and non-compete wording returned nothing. This sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback, so there is no need to negotiate a category/12-month limitation or a performance-based exit.
